searchText: You can say it's outside of the chain conensus, but it's definitly part of the protocol. <@412614104222531604> Did you get chance to look at this feedback? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/764#pullrequestreview-4318154696 Just implement it. Its already in Erigon, Prysn and Nethermind. Its not a big change Also it not being part of consensus makes all the difference I still don’t get it how it’s a protocol change I would not go step by step for something like this If you change the response format of method defined by spec, tha'ts a protocol change. You add a new protocol. You dont change anything Its an append not an edit It is implemented for the Lodestar as well, but highliging ambigious specs is a sperate thing. Not a strong reason to hand wave an ambiguous specs, while there is a nicer way to have clear seperation between JSON-RPC and REST If you guys think it's not a change then why not update this section to clear up the ambigious response format capabilites https://github.com/barnabasbusa/execution-apis/blob/949d6a83600271d91075fe359a8e27a06c1c67a5/src/engine/common.md#capabilities <@412614104222531604> If you through my feedback, there is nicer way to not mix up JOSN-RPC methods and REST endpoints in existing method.
